control_metadata.title: Cryptography (Insecure Randomness)
control_metadata.summary: Security-sensitive code should use cryptographically strong randomness rather than predictable PRNGs.

remediation.rationale: Local randomness upgrades can often be made safely with narrow replacements to SecureRandom-based APIs.
